title: Independent auto repair: NY license identity and published business-contact safeguards
hypothesis: The live Maps-first auto-repair route can identify an independent repair business, while the implemented New York DMV repair-shop register can corroborate a current named licensee. Neither a licensee name nor a published shop line establishes an owner-confirmed mobile; delivery requires the existing permitted-contact and independent ownership gates.
ownerSource: NY DMV nhjr-rpi2 RS and RSB rows retain a person-like owner_name only after the adapter's current-expiration and traceable-person checks. That named licensee is an owner candidate, not confirmation of ownership or of any handset.
phoneSource: The NY DMV repair-shop register has no phone field. A separately published business phone from the Maps-first route is a business-contact candidate only and cannot be promoted to an owner mobile without separate evidence.

workflow.label: Discover auto-repair business
workflow.detail: Start with the live recipe-A auto repair shop query and retain a named business candidate.

workflow.label: Repair-service relevance
workflow.detail: Require auto repair, mechanic, automotive repair, transmission, or brake evidence; tire, oil-change, body-shop, detailing, inspection, dealer, or parts-only evidence is insufficient by itself.

workflow.label: Hold off-trade candidate
workflow.detail: Reject or review a generic automotive, franchise, dealer, parts, or adjacent-only candidate.

workflow.label: Independent-business check
workflow.detail: Apply the existing auto brand exclusion before treating a candidate as an independent repair business.

workflow.label: Optional NY DMV corroboration
workflow.detail: For NY, use a current RS or RSB row only as repair-license and named-licensee candidate evidence; expired rows, entity names, and other facility types do not establish an owner.

workflow.label: Published business phone present?
workflow.detail: A separately published shop number is a business-contact candidate. The NY DMV row contributes no phone.

workflow.label: Hold: no permitted contact
workflow.detail: Keep identity evidence only; do not infer a phone from a repair license or owner candidate.

workflow.label: Verify permitted business contact
workflow.detail: Apply existing line-type, live, DNC, and global delivery-dedupe checks to the published business-contact candidate.

workflow.label: Independent owner evidence?
workflow.detail: A DMV owner_name, a name matching a business, or a shop line alone does not prove current business ownership or ownership of a handset.

workflow.label: Hold business contact
workflow.detail: Retain a permitted business-contact classification when independent owner evidence is absent.

workflow.label: Deliver approved contact
workflow.detail: Deliver only after contact/compliance checks and separate owner evidence pass; owner-confirmed mobile needs its own evidence.

edges.label: generic, adjacent-only, dealer, parts, or franchise candidate
line-type, live, DNC, and dedupe passed

failures.risk: A generic auto-repair request in NY routes to the national Maps-first entry and bypasses the existing NY DMV repair-shop register route.
failures.mitigation: Make state-aware routing select auto_repair_ny for a normal auto-repair request in NY, or merge the NY source selection into auto_repair while preserving the historical benchmarks.

failures.risk: NY DMV owner_name is represented as owner confirmation or as evidence that a shop phone belongs to that person.
failures.mitigation: Keep a traceable person as a named licensee candidate only; require independent current ownership and handset evidence before an owner or owner-mobile label.

failures.risk: Tire, lube, collision, detailing, inspection, dealer, parts, or franchise businesses are admitted as independent general repair shops.
failures.mitigation: Require a repair core term and apply the auto brand exclusion; route adjacent-only and chain candidates to hold or rejection.

failures.risk: A license row without a phone is treated as a contactable business or triggers an unapproved append path.
failures.mitigation: Use NY DMV rows as identity-only in this review and hold when no separately published business contact exists.

iterations.hypothesis: The verified NY DMV endpoint still returns current RS/RSB repair rows with a named licensee but no phone field, matching the adapter's identity-only use.
iterations.test: One free aggregate-only live query of five NY RS/RSB rows with 2027 text expiration on 2026-09-24; no names, addresses, or phone values retained.
iterations.observed: 5/5 rows returned; 5/5 had owner_name and facility_name; 4/5 were RS and 1/5 RSB; 5/5 owner_name values were person-like under the adapter's entity-token screen; 0/5 exposed a phone-named response field.
iterations.change: Keep the register identity-only and retain verifiedPhones at zero. The review identifies routing, rather than source field coverage, as the implementable shared correction.

measurement.result: NY DMV nhjr-rpi2 aggregate field-coverage query limited to five 2027 RS/RSB rows: 5/5 owner_name present; 5/5 facility_name present; RS 4/5; RSB 1/5; owner_name person-like under an entity-token screen 5/5; response fields named phone or telephone 0/5. No contact values, person names, or addresses were retained. This does not measure current ownership, mobile status, reachability, DNC, or delivery.

cost.basis: Free public-source field-coverage observation only; no paid discovery, append, or verification was invoked.
cost.note: No clean delivered owner-contact outcome was measured. The live brain's historical Anas figures use a different denominator and remain outside this review.

implementation.summary: The generic auto_repair entry is implemented as recipe A, and NY DMV RS/RSB parsing is implemented under the separate auto_repair_ny entry. matchIndustry does not select that NY entry for a normal auto-repair request, so the source-specific route is unreachable through the ordinary industry/state request.

nextMeasurement: After state-aware routing is corrected, use synthetic route cases to verify that auto repair plus NY selects the NY register source while auto repair plus another state remains Maps-first. Then run an authorized outcome study that measures trade fit, owner confirmation, line type, DNC, reachability, and delivery separately.
